_Generated 2026-08-14 by /mol:map._

## Inventory (package-tree)

Rules source: `CLAUDE.md` §"Architecture" (+ §"Design preferences (default)"). Boundary
test: `tests/test_repository_boundaries.py`. Four packages under `src/`: **molix**
(training/execution base) ← **molrep** (representation) ← **molzoo** / **molpot**
(recipes / physics). `molix.data` / `molix.datasets` were dissolved 2026-08-14 —
batching lives in `molix.batch`, storage in `molix.store`, dataset acquisition in
**MolHub** (separate repo).

---

### Module list

**molix — training / execution base layer** (`src/molix/`)
- `src/molix/` (root `__init__.py`) — native op-library loader (`_load_ops_library`, `ensure_op_registered`, arch-tagged `libmolnex_opLib.<machine>.so`); warns, does not fail, on missing/ABI-mismatched `.so`. Eager re-export façade of the training essentials.
- `src/molix/core/` — trainer loop + contracts: `trainer.py` (`Trainer`), `state.py` (`TrainState`, `Stage`, `StepResult`, `resolve`, `display`), `hook.py` (`Hook` Protocol, `BaseHook`, `ScalarHook` — the *singular* contract module), `metrics.py` (`Metric`/`BaseMetric` + MAE/RMSE/MSE/R2/Accuracy/`MetricCollection`/molecule-centered variants), `protocols.py` (`TaskProtocol`, `WorkflowProtocol`), `seed.py`, `audit.py` (new) — per-task/per-group gradient-norm probe (`TaskGradientProbe`, `TaskGradientSnapshot`, `GradientBalanceReport`).
- `src/molix/core/checkpoint/` — `Checkpoint`, pluggable `CheckpointBackend`/`TorchSaveBackend`, RNG capture/restore.
- `src/molix/core/losses/` — generic tensor losses (`combined`/`energy`/`force`) + `molecular.py` molecular-ML presets, incl. `ParsleyEnergyWeight` (new), `ProjectedInternalHessianLoss`, `TorsionProfileLoss`, `ChargeMSELoss`, `ScaleNormalizedLoss`.
- `src/molix/core/steps/` — `Step` protocol, `DefaultTrainStep`/`DefaultEvalStep`, `batch_to`, `multitask.py` (new) — `TaskSpec`/`TaskRouter`/`MultiTaskTrainStep`/`MultiTaskEvalStep` (override only the `compute_loss` seam; losses arrive pre-constructed so molix gains no molpot dep).
- `src/molix/batch/` **(new home; ex-`molix.data`)** — samples → collated batch, no file IO. `collate.py` (the one flat-dict→nested-TensorDict conversion point, `INDEX_KEYS`/rebase), `neighbor.py` (pipeline-side `NeighborList`, owner of the Edge Convention, base-class-free `task_id`+`execute`), `sampler.py` (token-budget packing, task-mixture), `datamodule.py` (DDP-aware `DataModule` over *prebuilt* datasets; `_CollateFn`/`_PackedCollateFn` fast path), `group_split.py`, `task.py` (`BatchTask`), `pad.py` (fixed-shape padder), `valence_columns.py` (kernel-local column→COO stacks), `bond_adapter.py` (molpy bonds block → `(2, N)` `bond_index`).
- `src/molix/store/` **(new home; ex-`molix.data.cache`/`dataset`)** — bytes↔tensors only. `cache.py` (`PackedCache`, single-`.pt` packed buckets + `atom_ptr`/`edge_ptr`), `dataset.py` (`BaseDataset`, `MmapDataset`, `CachedDataset`, `SubsetDataset`, `PackedView`).
- `src/molix/io/` — training-run IO: `metrics.py` (MolRec JSONL interchange), `run_record.py` (run-package scaffold), `writer.py`/`reader.py` (Zarr journal), `extxyz.py` (moved in) — numpy-only extxyz codec (no ASE).
- `src/molix/hooks/` — concrete hook implementations (plural = implementations; direction `hooks/ → io/ + core/`): checkpoint, early-stop, gpu, journal, molrec_metrics, profiler, progress, scalar, tensorboard, training, `audit.py` (new) — `GradientBalanceHook` cadence wrapper over `core/audit.py`.
- `src/molix/md/` — in-process compilable MD: `driver.py` (`MD`, `MaxwellBoltzmann`), `forcefield.py` (bind model→system), `integrators.py` (NVE/Langevin velocity-Verlet), `neighbors.py` (rebuilding fixed-capacity list, LAMMPS every/delay/check policy — distinct from `molix.batch.neighbor`), `runner.py` (`MDRunner` + MD hooks), `types.py` (pytree contracts).
- `src/molix/engine/` — engine-neutral export bridge: `adapter.py` (`EngineAdapter`/`EngineForward`/`FlatTensorAdapter`/`MolnexTensorDictAdapter`), `static.py` (`StaticForward`), `export.py` (`export_for_lammps` preset + `LAMMPS_META_SCHEMA`).
- `src/molix/ff_export/` — Class-I `PotentialIR` → backend `ForceSpec` → LAMMPS/OpenMM files via `molpy.io`; peer `BackendAdapter`s registered on import.
- `src/molix/nn/` — `KeyedMLP`, scatter modules. `src/molix/F/` — stateless functional API over `torch.ops.molix` (locality/pot/scatter).
- `src/molix/profiler/` — five standalone profilers (task/module/dataloader/dataset/trainer) + mock data generators; no Trainer/hook coupling.
- `src/molix/cli/` — Typer `molnex` console script (`check` → `Doctor`).
- Top-level modules: `config.py` (`config["ftype"]` dtype singleton), `compile.py` (`Compiler`), `export.py` (`Exporter`, AOTInductor), `quant.py` (`QuantScheme` family, `Quantizer`, `EffectiveTemperature`), `schema.py` (post-collate key constants + `has_energy`/`has_forces`), `units.py` (shared `molpy.UnitSystem`), `logger.py`/`logging.py` (mollog-backed stdlib facade).
- `src/molix/op/` — C++/CUDA sources + CMake (non-Python; produces the arch-tagged op library).

**molrep — representation blocks** (`src/molrep/`)
- `embedding/` — node/angular/radial/cutoff/MLP primitives + `mace.py` (MACE-only `EmbeddingBlock`), `covalent.py`, `support.py` (kNN chemical-support bank).
- `interaction/` — shared equivariant blocks (aggregation, contraction, element, gate, linear, product, product_basis, radial, residual) + family namespaces `interaction/mace/` (block/conv/density) and `interaction/pinet/` (pure GC blocks, no energy/force). `interaction/density.py` is a deprecated re-export shim → `interaction.mace.density`.
- `readout/` — `mace.py` (canonical: `ProductHead`, `LinearReadout`, `NonLinearReadout`, `NonLinearBiasReadout`), `pooling.py`, `projection.py`; `product.py` and `scalar.py` are deprecated re-export shims → `readout.mace`.
- `heads/` — representation-side heads only (`ScalarHead`, `TypeHead`/`MultiTypeHead`, labelers); physical heads live in `molpot.heads`.
- `chem/` — continuous chemical perception (no energy, no molpot): `ChemEncoder`, `ChemGraphBlock`, embeddings, valence contexts, typing metrics/probe.
- `condensation/` — continuous MM params → discrete `TypeSystem` per `InteractionClass`; physics gating via injected `physical_eval` callable.
- `perception/` — symbolic SMARTS/SMIRKS binding (`SmartsMatcher` Protocol, `SymbolicForceField`, pattern registry).
- `analysis/` — latent-embedding diagnostics (must not import molpot/molzoo/condensation).
- `utils/` — geometry helpers (`NeighborGraphBuilder`, `SphericalBasis`, `GaussianRBF`, `CosineCutoff`).

**molpot — potentials / physics heads** (`src/molpot/`)
- `potentials/` — `base.py` (`BasePotential`), valence families `bonds/`, `angles/`, `dihedrals/`, `impropers/`, `vdw/`; `nonbonded.py`, `repulsion.py` (ZBL), `polarization.py`, `mixing.py`; `elec/` (vendored-lineage Ewald/PME/P3M stack: `calculators/`, `potentials/`, `kernels/`, `lib/`, `tuning/`, `ewald_multipole.py`, `prefactors.py`).
- `derivation/` — one type per differentiated quantity: `force.py` (`ForceDerivation`), `hessian.py` (new) (`HessianDerivation`, flat `i = 3a + c` layout), `stress.py`, `energy.py`/`energy_readout.py`/`force_readout.py`, `kernels.py` (`grad_force_pass`/`func_force_pass`), `protocol.py` (batch key contract + session side-channel), `modes/` (`GradMode`/`FuncMode`).
- `heads/` — physical heads: energy, edge, dipole, multipole, electrostatics, element tables, charge_bond, charge_response, rescale, type; `provenance/` (coverage regime, parameter provenance, support classifier).
- `composition/` — `PotentialComposer`, `Sonata`/`SonataSpec`, generic + MM parameter heads (`heads.py`, `mm_heads.py`), `MultiHead`, `pooling.py`.
- `forcefield/` — `container.py` (`ForceField(molpy.ForceField)`, `OPLSAAForceField`), `parameterizer.py` (`Parameterizer`), `potentials.py` (`Potentials`), `schema.py`, `neighbor_list.py`, `pair_terms.py`, `wilson.py` (new) (`WilsonBMatrix`, `B = ∂q_int/∂x`), `predictions.py` (new) (`ForceFieldPredictions` — one hop model→per-task mapping; owns no derivative).
- `charge/` — charge equilibration: `assignment.py` (`AtomicChargeModel`), `chi_eta.py`, `problem.py`, `kernels/`, `solvers/` (algorithm-named `ElectronegativityEqualization`).
- `ir/` — Class-I intermediate representation: parameter `bags.py`, `potential_ir.py`, `scaling.py`, `units.py` (`UnitTag`, `CLASS_I_CANONICAL`).
- `pooling/` — encoder-output → energy adapters (layer/edge/graph).

**molzoo — encoder recipes / foundation models** (`src/molzoo/`)
- `mace/` — `spec` (torch-free configs), `geometry` (PBC edge vectors), `encoder`, `research` (`MACE` configurable encoder), `potential` (`MACEPotential`), `variants` (`MACEMatpes`, `MACEOMol`), `checkpoint` (key remaps).
- `pinet/` — `spec`, `geometry`, `encoder` (`PiNet`), `potential` (energy + functorch forces), `properties` (dipole/polarizability).
- `chem/` — `ChemPerception` recipe over `molrep.chem.ChemEncoder` + `ChemPerceptionSpec`.
- `allegro.py` — single-module Allegro encoder + spec.
- `specs/` — per-encoder 10-section markdown specs (`mace.md`, `mace_matpes.md`, `mace_omol.md`, `allegro.md`, `pinet2.md`); not code.

### Style summary

- **molix** — naming: types are nouns with role suffixes (`*Hook` for concrete hooks, `*Profiler`/`*Result` pairs, `*Dataset`, `*Sampler`, `*Adapter`, `*Writer`/`*Reader`); singular `core/hook.py` = contract, plural `hooks/` = implementations; `_leading_underscore` for private helpers and internal collate/dataset classes. Construction: direct `Class(...)` with **keyword-only tails** (`*,` in 113 of 303 files); fluent composition on the MD driver (`MD(dtype).set_forcefield(...).set_integrator(...)`); no `make_*`/`build_*`/`create_*` façades except `molix/core/seed.py::make_generator` / `make_worker_init_fn` (torch-object producers) and `EngineAdapter.build_inputs` (a method, not a factory). `from __future__ import annotations` is near-universal (211 files). Errors: `ValueError` dominates repo-wide (499 raises vs 38 `TypeError` / 36 `RuntimeError`), always with an f-string naming the offending key/shape; `TrainState.__setitem__` raises `ValueError` on slash/tuple **writes**; the op-library loader deliberately `warnings.warn`s instead of raising, and only `ensure_op_registered` raises `RuntimeError`. Docstrings: Google style with `Args:`/`Returns:`/`Raises:` (156 files), tensor shapes in double backticks, module docstrings carrying the design rationale; new physics-adjacent modules (`core/audit.py`, `core/steps/multitask.py`) add explicit LaTeX-ish math and `Units:` sections.
- **molrep** — naming: `Block`/`Layer`/`Head`/`Embedding` suffixes; every configurable block pairs a `nn.Module` with a pydantic `XxxSpec(BaseModel)` (34 `*Spec(BaseModel)` repo-wide, 18 with `ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)`). Construction: `nn.Module.__init__` with explicit dims (no `LazyLinear`), `register_buffer` for constants (92 sites repo-wide) with dtype from `molix.config["ftype"]` (133 `config.ftype` reads); Spec objects passed in rather than kwarg blobs. Errors: `ValueError` on irreps/shape mismatch. Docstrings: Google + `Reference:` block with arXiv/DOI (51 files repo-wide carry `Reference:`). Deprecated locations are kept as thin re-export shims with a `# noqa: F401` and a named removal step.
- **molpot** — naming: physical-quantity types (`ForceDerivation`, `HessianDerivation`, `StressDerivation`, `WilsonBMatrix`), `*Bag` for IR parameter containers, `*Head` for predictors, algorithm-named solvers (`ElectronegativityEqualization`) and kernels (`DiagonalHardnessKernel`). Construction: `BasePotential` subclasses = `nn.Module` + ABC, `forward(batch) -> batch`/scalar; derivation types are stateless `nn.Module`s constructed once and reused; model is always the **first positional** argument (`EnergyReadout(model, method=..., backward=...)`), remaining options keyword-only; `@dataclass(frozen=True)` (21 sites repo-wide) for IR bags/records. Errors: `ValueError` with a physics-explicit message; `BondHarmonic` rejects an `(E, 2)` tensor passed as `bond_index` (type-level anti-alias guard); `UnsupportedTermError` in the export path. Docstrings: heaviest `Reference:` + explicit units (`kcal mol⁻¹ Å⁻¹`, eV/Å, energy/Å²) and index-layout statements (`i = 3a + c`).
- **molzoo** — naming: model name = class name (`MACE`, `PiNet`, `Allegro`, `ChemPerception`), config = `<Model>Spec`, checkpoint remaps as module-level `UPPER_SNAKE` presets. Construction: `TensorDictModuleBase` subclasses with `forward(td) -> td`, built from a Spec or explicit keywords; foundation variants constructed by keyword (`MACEMatpes(...)`) with `load_*_state_dict` for weights. Import policy is the distinguishing idiom: **lazy PEP 562 `__getattr__` + `__dir__` mirroring `__all__`**, so config reads never pull cuEquivariance; `AttributeError` (not `ImportError`) on an unknown name. Docstrings: long expository module headers plus mandatory `Reference:` arXiv links; per-encoder specs live in `src/molzoo/specs/<encoder>.md`.

### Layer roles

- **`molix` = base layer.** Owns the dtype singleton (`molix.config`), the batch schema (`molix.batch.collate`), the `TrainState` namespace contract, hooks/steps, storage, IO, MD, and the leaf execution utilities (`compile`/`export`/`engine`/`quant`/`profiler`). Documented one-way rule: `molix ← molrep ← molzoo / molpot`.
- **Verified edges (import audit of `src/`)**: `molrep → molix` (29 refs, all `molix.config` / `molix.F`); `molpot → molix` (19) and `molpot → molrep` (`embedding.covalent`, `embedding.cutoff`, `embedding.mlp`, `embedding.support`, `condensation.classes`); `molzoo → molix` (5), `molzoo → molrep`, `molzoo → molpot` (`derivation`, `heads`, `potentials.repulsion` — the scoped encoder-co-location exception in CLAUDE.md); `molpot → molzoo`: **none**; `molrep → molpot/molzoo`: **none**.
- **One documented-graph exception exists in-tree**: `molix.ff_export` imports upward from molpot — `compiler.py`/`adapter.py`/`lammps_adapter.py`/`openmm_adapter.py` import `molpot.ir` (`PotentialIR`, `NonbondedScaling`, `NonbondedMethodRecord`), `lammps_writer.py` imports `molpot.forcefield.ForceField` and, since `composable-a0-05` (2026-09-08), the public `molpot.lorentz_berthelot` — the exported `pair_coeff i j` lines are mixed by molnex's own rule so the deck matches molnex by construction and the mixing rule stays single-homed in molpot. Always import through the package's public surface (`molpot`, `molpot.ir`, `molpot.forcefield`), never a deep module path. This is the only `molix → molpot` edge (`molix.engine` takes the manifest as a plain `Mapping` for the same reason); CLAUDE.md names it under "Module Dependency Graph".
- **Intra-molix roles**: `molix.store` = persistence/reader layer (bytes ↔ tensors, no batching, no acquisition); `molix.batch` = sample→batch construction (no file IO, consumes `molix.store` readers); `molix.io` = run-artifact IO (metrics JSONL / Zarr journal / extxyz codec), consumed by `molix.hooks` (`hooks/ → io/ + core/`, never the reverse); `molix.core` = trainer + contracts, the innermost layer that neither `batch` nor `store` may import upward from.
- **Two distinct `NeighborList` types** — `molix.batch.neighbor.NeighborList` (pipeline-side cutoff-graph builder, owner of the Edge Convention, base-class free with `task_id`/`execute`) and `molix.md.neighbors.NeighborList` (rebuilding fixed-capacity MD list owning the `every`/`delay`/`check` policy, writes `("edges","shifts")`). Same name, different layer — specs must qualify which. **molpot never enumerates pairs** (since 2026-09-07, `composable-a0-03b`): `molpot.forcefield.Potentials._placed_pairs` consumes the placed `edges` namespace one of these two wrote and fails closed without it; the former `molpot/forcefield/neighbor_list.py` is deleted.
- **`molrep`** = reusable representation blocks only (embedding → interaction → readout, plus chem/condensation/perception/analysis side-trees). No energy, no force, no molpot import. `molrep.heads` ≠ `molpot.heads` (representation projections vs physical quantities).
- **`molpot`** = physics: potentials, physical heads, derivation (single entry `ForceDerivation` for `F = -dE/dpos`; `HessianDerivation` for `∂²E/∂pos²`), Class-I force-field container + IR. Must not import `molzoo` (verified clean).
- **`molzoo`** = encoder recipes / foundation checkpoints, the top of the graph; consumes `molrep` blocks and `molpot` derivation/heads.
- **MolHub owns dataset acquisition.** The ETL layer (`DataSource` / `PipelineSpec` / `Task` / dataset adapters) was deleted outright — no shim, no alias. Enforced by three tests in `tests/test_repository_boundaries.py`: (1) no `src/` module may import `molhub`; (2) `molix.data` / `molix.datasets` must not resolve via `importlib.util.find_spec` (a bare leftover directory acting as a namespace package also fails); (3) no file under `src`, `tests`, `scripts`, `regressions`, `benchmarks` (`.py/.pyi/.md/.txt/.yaml/.yml/.sbatch`) may mention `molix.data` / `molix/data` / `molix.datasets` — comments and prose included. Exemptions: that test file itself, and `regressions/molix-data-dissolution-*` scripts. New specs must retarget at `molix.batch` / `molix.store` / `molix.io`, or at MolHub for acquisition.
- **Deprecated-shim inventory (chain step `mace-subpackage-restructure-01`, slated for removal in `06-wire`)**: `src/molrep/readout/product.py`, `src/molrep/readout/scalar.py`, `src/molrep/interaction/density.py` are re-export shims; `molrep/__init__.py` still resolves `ProductHead` through the `readout.product` shim rather than the canonical `molrep.readout.mace`.

**Hard-rule reminders for librarian:**
1. Dependency: `molix` ← `molrep` ← `molzoo` / `molpot` (`molpot ↛ molzoo`); known real exception `molix.ff_export → molpot` (see Layer roles).
2. Two-tier data: flat dict pre-collate; nested plain `TensorDict` post-collate (`atoms`/`edges`/`graphs`/`bonds`). Single conversion point `molix.batch.collate.collate_molecules`.
3. Edge: `edge_index[:,0]=source`, `edge_diff = pos[target]-pos[source]`; `bond_index` is `(2,N)` COO.
4. Cache: `PackedCache` (`molix.store.cache`) — never `TensorDict.memmap_()`. READY-tier block store (`molix.store.block`) in flight under spec `streaming-data-tiers-02-block-format`.
5. Forces: single entry `ForceDerivation`; default `autograd` (cuEq-safe); `functorch` only for pure-torch energy graphs. Hessians: `HessianDerivation` (autograd-only).
6. Dataset acquisition / ETL / dataset adapters belong to **MolHub** — do not spec them into molnex.

## Custom annotation — `interface/` (LAMMPS plugin), pending next /mol:map regen

_Added 2026-08-30 after the `lammps-iface` chain (01-meta … 05-pbc) closed; the
managed block above predates it. Fold into the inventory on the next `/mol:map`
run (do not run it against a tree carrying another workstream's WIP)._

**`interface/` — C++ engine bridge, three layers (repo root, not `src/`):**

- **Facade** — `interface/lammps/pair_molnex.{h,cpp}`: `pair_style molnex`
  protocol mechanics only (settings/coeff token piping, neighbor request,
  compute forwarding, ev tally, comm pack/unpack forwarding). Zero semantic
  branches; written once, generally never changed.
- **Bridge** — `interface/lammps/bridge/`: LAMMPS-free, unit-testable
  components. `lammps_view.h` (POD span view, the only LAMMPS-type seam),
  `species_map`, `node_staging`, `graph_bridge` (neighbor list → edge tensors;
  walks `inum+gnum`; sorts iff `requires_sorted_edges`), `force_scatter`,
  `comm_reverse` (dormant seam — reduction ownership is the integrator's global
  reverse comm), `exec.h` (`Exec` base + `ModelOutputs`), `dynamic_exec`,
  `graphed_exec` (CUDA-graph 5-input path). Static lib `molnex_lammps_bridge`.
- **Impls** — `interface/lammps/impls/`: one impl per **runtime-contract
  family**, never per network. `cutoff_graph_impl` serves PiNet/MACE/Allegro
  alike; `registry.cpp` dispatches on `Contract` with an exhaustive switch
  (`fixed_graph` declared, rejected until its consumer spec lands — see
  notes.md topic `lammps-iface-post-chain`).
- **Engine-neutral core** — `interface/include/molnex/interface/`
  (`meta_schema.h`, `model_runner.h`) + `interface/src/model_runner.cpp`:
  meta.json schema-v3 reader and AOTI runner, no LAMMPS types.
- **Python counterpart** — `src/molix/engine/` (`export_for_lammps`,
  `EngineForward` 4-input / `StaticForward` 5-input, `LAMMPS_META_SCHEMA = 3`).
  The schema version is pinned on both sides and must bump together
  (`regressions/lammps-iface-01-meta.py`).
- **Tests** — `interface/tests/` (ctest; fixture generation needs an absolute
  `PYTHONPATH` to `src/`). Toolchain: `interface/.clang-format`, gated in CI.
